_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
I ye Player {player_id} ye Liar's Dice jɛri kɔnɔ, {num_players} jumɛnɛw na.
Kalanw:
- Ni i ka tɔɔ, i bɛɛ:
  1) Kɛɛ bid kɛnɛɛnɛ fɔɔlonɛnɛ, quantity bee face (bee ɲɔgɔn) ka ca a ka ca bid kɔnɔ; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kɛɛ call kɛnɛɛnɛ fɔɔlonɛnɛ, '[Call]' bɛɛ.

Ni i kɛɛ call:
  - Ni a ka count kɛnɛɛnɛ fɔɔlonɛnɛ, a ka face value kɔnɔ, bee bid kɔnɔ, a ka last bidder kɔnɔ die kɛnɛɛnɛ.
  - Bee, a ka caller kɔnɔ die kɛnɛɛnɛ.
Jumɛnɛw ka bɔ 0 dice kɔnɔ, a kɛɛ eliminated. A ka last remaining player kɔnɔ wins.

board.new_round:
Dɛmɛ sababu - Kɔnɔnw ye: {dice_summary}
O kɔnɔnw ye: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} kɛɛ call! A ka actual count kɛnɛɛnɛ fɔɔlonɛnɛ, face {face_value} kɔnɔ, bee {count}, bee LESS ka {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (a ka last bidder) kɔnɔ die kɛnɛɛnɛ.
call.caller_loses:
Jɛlɛ {current_player_id} gɛlɛ! Kɛɲɛ kɛlɛfɛnw {face_value} ye kɛɲɛ kɛlɛfɛnw {count} ye, o ye >= {quantity} ye.
Jɛlɛ {loser_id} (gɛlɛkɛlɛ) bɛɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ ka kɛlɛfɛnw ye.

action.bid_announce: Player {player_id} kɛɛ bid {quantity} kɛnɛɛnɛ fɔɔlonɛnɛ, face {face_value}.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: A ye weleli kɛ ni wari hakɛ ma di fɔlɔ.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Ara ye ka ca '[Bid: X, Y]' wa '[Call]'. Ara ye: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Saba kɔnɔn {new_quantity} ye misiila ka ca {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Saba naani {new_face_value} ye misiila ka ca {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Sigiyɔrɔ kelen bɛ yen ni sisan ta ye.
bid_reason.face_range: A tɔgɔda-sɛbɛnni ka kan ka kɛ 1 ni 6 cɛ.

message.eliminated_invalid: Jalakɛla {player_id} bɔra ɲɔgɔndan na a ka jɔyɔrɔ tiɲɛni kama.
